extracted.name: Zucchini Saute
extracted.description: Zucchini is sauteed with red onion, mushrooms, tomato and herbs. You can use any veggies you like. Serve over pasta, if desired.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Saute onion with salt and pepper for 2 minutes. Stir in zucchini and mushrooms. When zucchini begins to soften, add tomatoes, garlic and Italian seasoning. Cook until heated through.
